airport.disclaimer: Terminal footprints, gates, facilities and levels are derived from OpenStreetMap and are not field-verified. Hall, entrance, security and gate connectors are inferred schematic links, not surveyed corridors. Follow airport signs and staff instructions.
airport.liveFlightSource: Live provider lookup when configured; manual entry and demo flights always work. The BLR airport board is used only for BLR.

notes: Terminal 2 is the integrated terminal. Confirm the terminal on airport screens.
